data.revised_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Desktop visual design concept for a premium international logistics website, one full page image.
Primary request: FreightVanta Cross-Border Ecommerce industry solution page, showing an original high-end B2B web design that is clearly distinct from a generic service page. The page tells a connected operational story from China sourcing to customer-ready ecommerce orders.
Scene/backdrop: Deep navy hero panel paired with a real editorial fulfillment workbench image, followed by cool blue process band, bright white sales-channel ledger section, deep navy operating scope section, white inventory-control image section, and pale blue final inquiry band.
Subject: A complete 1440px-wide desktop website design mockup, long-scroll editorial layout. Hero H1 must be visibly readable in large clean white type: KEEP THE ECOMMERCE HANDOFFS CONNECTED AFTER YOU SOURCE FROM CHINA. Include a small FreightVanta wordmark in header. Use section headings as short readable English labels only: CONNECTED WORKFLOW, SALES CHANNELS, OPERATING CONTROLS, INVENTORY WITH CONTEXT, START YOUR PLAN.
Style/medium: High-fidelity web UI design render, premium American B2B logistics brand, precise Swiss-inspired editorial layout, restrained visual system, actual professional art direction.
Composition/framing: Wide desktop screenshot-like overview of a full landing page, 1440px desktop frame, generous clear hierarchy, left-aligned grid, thin dividers, image-led hero.
Lighting/mood: Confident, intelligent, calm and operational. Natural light in real warehouse imagery.
Color palette: Deep navy #082e5a, white, cool blue #dcebf6, muted steel blue, safety orange #ef6b35 for CTAs, restrained mint only for operational route accents.
Materials/textures: Real cartons, handheld barcode scanner, packing materials, structured inventory shelving; crisp paper and UI surfaces.
Text (verbatim): "KEEP THE ECOMMERCE HANDOFFS CONNECTED AFTER YOU SOURCE FROM CHINA" and "FREIGHTVANTA". All other visible copy should be clean short editorial placeholder blocks, not gibberish.
Constraints: no gradients, no glassmorphism, no oversized metrics, no rounded floating card grid, no decorative circles, no map/globe, no fake analytics dashboard, no stock-photo handshake, no website chrome/browser frame, no competitor marks, no external logos, no watermarks.
Avoid: illegible tiny text, fantasy warehouse, AI decorative blobs, purple palette, beige body background, generic SaaS landing page.
